title: KyuLib
description: A library of stuff and things for Kaekyu's creations.
body:
A library that provides resources such as functions or items for use in my datapacks and other creations.
It also contains the root file(s) for the advancements tab used to show content added/changed by my other datapacks.

This is mainly intended for my own personal use.

I highly reccommend using a mod like [Paxi](https://modrinth.com/mod/paxi) to autoload datapacks from the <modpack>\datapacks\ folder, otherwise you would have to manually add the datapack to the "datapacks" folder rooted in your world files.
